patch.value: Update the development coverage toolchain for glob cancellation advisory

Dependency installation and a full credential-free npm audit report three moderate development dependency findings through c8, test-exclude and glob. Advisory GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 describes AbortSignal cancellation bypass and post-timeout filesystem traversal in glob versions >=9.0.0 <=14.0.1: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 . The audit proposes a major c8 downgrade to 9.1.0; do not downgrade or weaken the existing coverage gate. Find a compatible patched toolchain, preserve all release thresholds, and verify npm and Bun gates. This differs from the already-closed braces/micromatch advisory item pm-jev-2rp1; exact-advisory tracker search found no existing item. No production exploit is established by this development dependency audit. Dependency changes are outside PR 92 review-round scope.
Resolve GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 without downgrading coverage or relaxing thresholds; pass npm and Bun full release gates.
